headword: {連載終了|れんさいしゅうりょう}
reading: れんさいしゅうりょう

definitions.gloss: end of serialization; conclusion of a series
definitions.explanation: The conclusion or discontinuation of a work that has been published in installments, most commonly used for manga series in magazines but also applicable to novels, columns, or web series.

examples.japanese: あの{漫画|まんが}が{連載終了|れんさいしゅうりょう}した。
{連載終了|れんさいしゅうりょう}の{発表|はっぴょう}にファンから{悲|かな}しみの{声|こえ}が{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: When the end of serialization was announced, fans expressed their sadness.

examples.japanese: 10{年|ねん}{続|つづ}いた{人気|にんき}{漫画|まんが}が{来月|らいげつ}{連載終了|れんさいしゅうりょう}を{迎|むか}えることが{明|あき}らかになった。
examples.english: It was revealed that the popular manga that ran for ten years will reach its conclusion next month.

notes:
Compound of {連載|れんさい} (serialization) and {終了|しゅうりょう} (end; conclusion). This is a key term in manga and publishing culture. A {連載終了|れんさいしゅうりょう} can be either a planned conclusion ({完結|かんけつ}) or an early cancellation ({打|う}ち{切|き}り).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連載終了|れんさいしゅうりょう}を{迎|むか}える: to reach the end of serialization
- {連載終了|れんさいしゅうりょう}が{発表|はっぴょう}される: end of serialization is announced
- {連載終了|れんさいしゅうりょう}{後|ご}: after serialization ends
- {惜|お}しまれつつ{連載終了|れんさいしゅうりょう}: ending serialization to widespread regret

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {完結|かんけつ}: completion, implies the story reached its intended conclusion
- {打|う}ち{切|き}り: cancellation, implies early termination due to low popularity
- {最終回|さいしゅうかい}: final episode/installment, refers to the last chapter itself
